notes:
v4.6.111 — Take-profit reliability, correct Total P/L, chart timeframes, full account value

🛟 Fixed the recurring 'price flew past the take-profit but nothing sold' bug at the root: the DAY bot's bracket re-arm was building stop/take-profit levels from a missing (zero) entry price, producing garbage orders that left positions unprotected. Positions now carry their real average entry, so the take-profit/stop-loss re-arm correctly and fire.

📊 Total P/L is now correct. It previously showed a large bogus gain because it counted capital ADDED when newer bots were created as 'profit'. It now compares each bot's value to the money actually allocated to it (deposit-proof).

📈 The bot equity chart now responds to the timeframe selector (1W/1M actually redraw the week/month), and trade-event markers are clipped to the visible window so old trades don't squash a 1-day curve.

💰 The Overview now shows your FULL IBKR account value (bots + unallocated cash) next to BOTS VALUE.

Update via the in-app banner.
